paper_title: No evidence for axions from Chandra observation of magnetic white dwarf
notes: Paper reports a mass-independent (flat) upper limit on g_agamma ≲ 5.5×10^-13 GeV^-1 √(C_agamma/C_aee) for m_a ≲ 5×10^-6 eV from non-observation of X-rays from magnetic white dwarf RE J0317-853. The limit is stated as valid for axion masses well below 5×10^-6 eV. The paper also provides a more conservative limit of g_agamma ≳ 4.4×10^-11 GeV^-1 when accounting for loop-induced C_aee ≈ 1.5×10^-4 C_agamma (W-phobic scenario). The primary constraint reported in the abstract and main text is the product g_aee*g_agamma ≲ 1.3×10^-25 GeV^-1 for m_a ≪ 10^-5 eV. The limit on g_agamma alone depends on assumptions about the ratio C_agamma/C_aee. The data point provided represents the stated limit for the case C_aee = C_agamma (tree-level DFSZ-like scenario), which is nearly two orders of magnitude stronger than the loop-induced limit.
